_note: Experiments run on measured Munsell reflectances and CIE/synthetic illuminants (the paper's LSPDD lamps need an account), rendered by the evaluator in each method's latent space. The paper reports no number on this exact protocol except the multi-bounce selection proxy; results.hadamard_k6 therefore holds this gym's reproduced held-out value where the paper has none, and the paper's own figures are kept under _paper_reported.

spectral_product_broadband.description: Single reflectance x light product under held-out broadband lights, exposed for the light. Paper: one-interaction accuracy of the k=6 two-pass code (Figs. 1, 4).

mean_delta_e94.description: Mean CIE94 colour error against the 47-sample spectral product.

spectral_nrmse.description: Mean per-sample ||decoded - true|| / ||true|| over the 47 samples.

spectral_product_narrowband.description: Single product under held-out spiky narrowband lights, the paper's stress case where RGB rendering shows large colour shifts (Figs. 1, 5).

mean_delta_e94.description: Mean CIE94 colour error against the 47-sample spectral product.

multibounce_narrowband.description: Three-reflectance chains under narrowband lights (Fig. 9 stress setting): repeated per-channel products in the code space.

mean_delta_e94.description: Mean CIE94 error after three interactions.

spectral_nrmse.description: Mean per-sample relative spectral error after three interactions.

multibounce_proxy.description: The paper's model-selection protocol (Sec. 4.5): held-out light x reflectance chains S1, S2, S3 with newly sampled reflectances, mean CIE94 per bounce, without re-exposure. 3,000 chains instead of 500; lights drawn half broadband, half narrowband.

rendered_scenes.description: Path-traced-style pixels: each pixel sums 30 weighted light paths of depth 1-8 from two lights (broadband or narrowband, random intensity) over ten held-out materials; per-scene auto-exposure. Exercises scaling, addition and products together as in the paper's rendered scenes and unbounded-depth tests (Figs. 4-9).

mean_delta_e94.description: Mean per-pixel CIE94 error against the spectral render.

hadamard_k6.note: Fig. 9 per-pixel image MSE for 1, 2, 3 and unbounded bounces in one Mitsuba scene; not on this gym's scale.

rgb_upsampling.description: Legacy-RGB assets: only each held-out asset's linear-sRGB value is given to the method's upsampler; the product (half broadband, half narrowband lights) is compared with the true spectral product (Sec. 5, Figs. 3-4).

mean_delta_e94.description: Mean CIE94 colour error of upsampled-asset products.

spectral_nrmse.description: Mean relative spectral error of upsampled-asset products.
